mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS concept_id, c.name AS name, COALESCE(c.source, 'ths') AS source, COALESCE(c.concept_type, 'other') AS concept_type FROM fundamental_concept_member m JOIN fundamental_concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id AS concept_id, c.index_code AS index_code, c.name AS name, COALESCE(c.source, 'ths') AS source, COALESCE(c.concept_type, 'other') AS concept_type, c.description AS description, m.reason AS reason FROM fundamental_concept_member m JOIN fundamental_concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id WHERE m.symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fundamental_concept_member WHERE concept_id = #{conceptId}

SELECT m.symbol AS symbol, s.name AS name, s.industry AS industry, s.market AS market, d.close AS latest_close, d.total_mv AS total_mv, d.pe_ttm AS pe_ttm FROM fundamental_concept_member m LEFT JOIN fundamental_stock_basic s ON s.symbol = m.symbol LEFT JOIN fundamental_daily_basic d ON d.symbol = m.symbol AND d.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM fundamental_daily_basic WHERE symbol = m.symbol) WHERE m.concept_id = #{conceptId} ORDER BY m.symbol LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
